themes.counterRead: AVGO has not repriced: fundamentals (+55% revenue) and price (-26.8%) are moving in opposite directions — the purest DATA_AHEAD setup in the input, tier A with a score of 81. The honest risk is the known classifier blind spot: it only sees trailing revenue plus price, so it cannot see a guidance-trajectory break of the kind that sank APP and TTD. Thesis verification before sizing, not auto-buy.
